metadata.name: RNP Backbone Reference Topology
metadata.description: Experimental topology derived from the supplied Neo4j Cypher script. Directional link declarations and repeated declarations are preserved. 'Compo Grande' is normalized to 'Campo Grande'. Capacity values are interpreted as Gb/s per user instruction; delay and packet loss are unspecified in the source and set to zero only as schema defaults.
metadata.author: Artigo
